title: Hand Controlled Drone
description: Drone controlled by hand tilt and finger movement.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: This was my longest and most complicated project. I developed a drone that can be controlled by hand movements. Tilting your hand controls the drone's flight direction, while moving your index finger controls the drone's level/throttle.

sections.title: Drone Controller Components
content: ATMEGA328P Microcontroller for parsing RF24 Data
STM32 Microcontroller for running PID loops and flight software

sections.title: Technical Implementation
sections.content: All schematics and PCBs were designed and made from scratch using EasyEDA PCB software. All components were hand-soldered for this project.
